description: Source code for a FastAPI-based REST API managing student attendance records, including endpoints for creating, listing, updating, deleting, marking in bulk, and exporting attendance data as CSV.

classes.name: AttendanceCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating attendance records.

classes.name: AttendanceUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating attendance records.

classes.name: AttendanceOut
classes.description: Pydantic model for returning attendance records.

classes.name: AttendanceMarkIn
classes.description: Pydantic model for bulk attendance marking input.

methods.name: create_attendance(attendance: AttendanceCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new attendance record if it does not already exist for the student on the given date.

methods.name: mark_attendance(attendance_in: AttendanceMarkIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Bulk marks attendance for multiple students.

methods.name: list_attendance(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all attendance records with optional pagination.

methods.name: get_attendance(attendance_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Fetches a specific attendance record by its ID.

methods.name: update_attendance(attendance_id: int, att_in: AttendanceUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates the attendance status for a specific record.

methods.name: delete_attendance(attendance_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))

export_attendance_csv(class_id: Optional[int] = None, student_id: Optional[int] = None, start_date: Optional[date] = None, end_date: Optional[date] = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Exports filtered attendance records as a CSV file.
